title: Clay roof tiles, barrel or pantile
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of a clay tile roof in overlapping courses: barrel tiles (concave pans with half-round covers) or S-shaped pantiles, with stepped noses and dark cavities, per-tile colour, glazed or unglazed finish, lichen, moss and dirt streaks. Use for Mediterranean, mission, rural and East Asian roofs.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python roof_tiles_clay.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: profile
parameters.meaning: 0 barrel tiles (concave pans with separate half-round covers over their joints), 1 pantiles (one S-shaped piece: a pan rising into a roll that laps the next pan).

parameters.name: columns
parameters.meaning: Profile repeats across the tile width (pan and cover pairs, or pantiles).

parameters.name: courses
parameters.meaning: Overlapping courses down the tile height.

parameters.name: cover_width
parameters.meaning: Share of each repeat taken by the convex cover or roll.

parameters.name: curvature
parameters.meaning: Depth of the curves across the slope.

parameters.name: course_step
parameters.meaning: Height of the step at each tile nose.

parameters.name: misalignment
parameters.meaning: Random offsets and tilts of individual tiles.

parameters.name: moss
parameters.meaning: Moss in the pans under the noses.

parameters.name: dirt
parameters.meaning: Dark streaks washed down the pans.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Terracotta barrel tiles with half-round covers and a little lichen.

presets.name: red_pantiles
presets.description: Even red pantiles in tight courses, recently laid.

presets.name: aged_mediterranean
presets.description: Faded, mottled barrel tiles with heavy lichen, moss and streaks.

presets.name: glazed_jade
presets.description: Glossy green glazed barrel tiles with narrow covers in many courses.

limits: The slope always runs down the tile height. Tiles are straight-sided curved profiles with no taper, ridge, hip, eaves or verge pieces, and the curvature lives in the height and normal maps only, so silhouettes stay flat without displacement. Crowns are tinted lighter and channels darker in the albedo as weathering, which reads as baked shading under strong grazing light. Lichen, moss and streaks are noise approximations. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced.
technique_references: Periodic cross-slope profile of concave pans and half-round covers
S-shaped pantile profile from a pan arc and a roll
Sawtooth course ramp for overlapping tile noses
Per-tile hashing for colour, course offset and tilt
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
